title: Prove P104 helper endpoint stops retain the 208-lifetime floor
body:
This scoped negative proof extends the P104 **208 new correction-helper lifetime floor to arbitrary nested refinements of the original G/Q/D transports**, with read-only contacts at every inserted stop. It answers a concrete changed-path case from the [actual-helper audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/p104-live-helper-reads/README.md). There are exactly **52 new target-endpoint contacts across 32 transports**, and every available source row is already in the freely granted root code. This rejects a specific correction mechanism before larger synthesis. It does not improve the complete kappa calculation; selected kappa remains 60403/20000000.

[Proof and exact domain](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/512dd853a8094fdfd34796a295ba2044a5b4c963/research/p104-helper-endpoint-stops/README.md), [all 52 contact rows](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/512dd853a8094fdfd34796a295ba2044a5b4c963/research/p104-helper-endpoint-stops/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/512dd853a8094fdfd34796a295ba2044a5b4c963/research/p104-helper-endpoint-stops/verify.py), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/512dd853a8094fdfd34796a295ba2044a5b4c963/research/p104-helper-endpoint-stops/SOURCES.json) are at reviewed head `512dd853a8094fdfd34796a295ba2044a5b4c963`. Base and all consumed source pins are `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`.

Keep all original scalar operations, source/target paths, captures, queries, cleanup and private lifetimes in order. Replace any helper jump V→W by a finite nested chain between the same endpoints. Added operations can read original helpers but cannot write them. This changes the prior fixed-path premise and creates actual endpoint contacts. However, every new endpoint row lies in K = row_Q(R), where R is the doubled-root matrix. At other inserted frames, the inherited K+U(V) invariant persists by inclusion. The original proof's “no endpoint contact” premise is replaced by “every endpoint contact has zero local component modulo K.” Its other quotient and spanning certificates then retain two new arrivals per incomparable target endpoint, hence 208 lifetimes for any finite combination of these refinements.

The complete census checks all 362 original helper transports against all 104 target endpoints by frame containment, then independently by binary annihilating normals. The 52 contacts reach 31 endpoints; all occur on D helpers. Forty split H4 into H3+H1; twelve split H3 into H2+H1. Each preserves rank mass, but strictly raises the standard tariff sum r^p for 0<p<1. Alternative endpoints on one jump are not claimed simultaneously feasible. The theorem grants all their code information for free, which only strengthens the obstruction.

From the repository root, Python 3.12 and standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/p104-helper-endpoint-stops/verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/p104-helper-endpoint-stops/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-helper-endpoint-stops
```

Expected direct marker: `PASS_P104_HELPER_ENDPOINT_STOPS`. Registered normal/optimized CPython 3.12.13 and optimized 3.14.7 pass. The new integer interpreter executes all 4,058 original events and separately all 52 actual split words, comparing every frame, profile delta and all 78,400 endpoint coefficients per word. The retained rational checker reruns 2,458 source-decomposition states and all 104 quotient/geometry certificates against its pinned receipt. Controls reject outside-code contamination, a real earlier unfinished outside-code row, wrong rank, missing cleanup and omitted contact; independent D/Q dirt remains explicit. Committed-byte and official 11-file export checks pass; the Git-free optimized extraction passes and rejects source and receipt corruption. Full-history preflight is not claimed from this shallow checkout.

This is a written uniform implication within the declared path-refinement class, with exact finite source premises. It is not an obstruction to changed captures, routes outside the original intervals, new descents, target feedback or arbitrary P104 programs. The inherited 208 theorem and source trace retain their attribution. No native phase lowering, physical scalar/tape implementation, global owner/precision invoice, selected cold replay, Lean/Docker run, independent human review, proof-kernel acceptance or full multiplication theorem is claimed. Hosted CI remains separate.

The [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-19151440) follows the changed-helper-path handoff. Final overlap covered 385 open PRs, 4,610 Discussion records and all 7,091 tracked README/TASK notes; no other matching endpoint-stop claim appeared. Canonical main still matched the base. Unpublished work and arbitrary diffs remain outside that coverage.

Credit @ywz65 for the actual-helper audit, @commdata2338 for the quotient extension in [PR #2383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2383), and @kumagi and Philippe Van Velzen for the relay floor retained in [PR #2353](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2353). Rohan Arun's source word, Chafik Boukhalfa's native inputs, Adam Gall's schedule, Josie Elliston's fixture and the complete geometry lineage retain their [source attribution](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/p104-live-helper-reads/README.md).
